decision.reason: [ev-d65610998fa2] is only a bare PR title, "feat: check-diff on update deps". It points to PR #4632 but does not say what changed. It names no component, flag, value or API (subject) and gives no before/after behaviour (change). It also says nothing about which environments are affected or what happens if the operator does nothing (applicability, consequence), even though the line appears under the BREAKING CHANGES heading. The PR description or diff would be needed to tell whether this is a user-facing change or an internal CI/dependency-update change.
